items.text: Hello everyone,
A new patch is available today for TDF 23!
Update of database (rider ratings and world champion jerseys).
Update of jerseys (Vuelta kit and national teams).
Correction of inconsistencies in the wearing of distinctive jerseys in My Tour.
Correction of non-respected fitness peaks in Pro Team and Pro Leader.
New kit without special jerseys in My Tour.
Database: update of ratings.
Database: correction of the nationality of the DSM team, from German to Dutch.
Database: update of world champions (M. Van der Poel and R. Evenepoel).
Visual adjustment: update (race, podium, UI) of national team jerseys (Germany, Denmark, Great Britain, Norway).
Visual adjustment: update of jerseys of the Vuelta kit (4 leader jerseys, Arkéa Samsic and Astana).
Visual adjustment: the world champion no longer wears his champion's helmet in the world championship.
Visual adjustment: the time-trial champions' jerseys are no longer worn in the team time-trial.
Visual adjustment: champions' jerseys are now worn in My Tour if national teams are used.
Gameplay: correction of non-respected fitness peaks when starting line-ups are changed during the season in Pro Team and Pro Leader.
Gameplay: correction to legendary riders available for the world championships in Pro Team.
Interface: correction of inverted Mountain and Time-trial medals on Pro Leader's progression page.
Interface: opponents not fully recovered from a fall are indicated on the results' page.
Possibility to use a jersey kit without Tour de France, Giro or Vuelta special jerseys in My Tour.
Hello riders,
The third update for Tour de France 2023 has arrived!
AI adjustment: riders now give it their all to compete for best climber points.
AI adjustment: team-mates who are stronger than the polka-dot jersey wearer no longer wait for him when the latter is dropped.
AI adjustment: improvement to the creation of the grupetto so that riders who could target a good GC position no longer ease up and needlessly lose time.
Visual adjustment: special Tour de France jerseys for Astana, Cofidis, Intermarché - Circus - Wanty, Israël - Premier Tech, Movistar, Soudal Quick-Step.
Visual adjustment: change of sponsor for the DSM team, who become DSM - Firmenich, and for the Trek Segafredo team who become Lidl- Trek.
Gameplay adjustment: bad race-day condition has more impact during time-trials, meaning larger gaps between riders in good condition and those who are struggling.
Visual adjustment: update of existing national champions.
Visual adjustment: addition of new national champions' jerseys (Slovenia, United States, Denmark, Ireland).
Correction of a bug: incorrect commentary on the Vulcania > Issoire stage.
Correction of a bug: in Pro Leader mode, Bonus Points now earn progression points.
Update of database: official Tour de France starting line-ups are present.
Update of database: rider ratings.
Update of database: addition of a missing Lotto Dstny rider (Jarne Van de Paar).
Update of database: removal of Gino Mäder (Bahrain Victorious).
Update of database: correction to a rider costing 0€ (S.Tu).
Removal of the mountains classification bonus on stage 1 of the TDF.
We pushed a new update in Beta for Tour de France 2023, if you're interested to try this update before it goes live on the public servers, here is how to join the Open Beta:
• Open Steam > Library
• Right-click on Tour de France 2023 > Properties
• Select Beta and select "open-beta" in the beta participation dropdown

The second update for Tour de France is here, with a series of fixes and improvements.

notes.title: A few details before reading the changelog

items.text: The "Open Beta" and "Default" branches are the same, however you must switch to the default branch to play the race of the moment, otherwise your result will not be taken into consideration.
The challenges of the moment will end earlier on Thursday morning to allow for the update.
Please also note that this patch does not contain the official start list for the 2023 TDF or the jerseys, as the patch was submitted before this information became official.

notes.title: Here's the list of fixes in tomorrow's update

items.text: Fix for the incorrect nationality of Welays Hagos Berhe (team Jayco Alula)
Fix for the message ‘Failed to send the results’ in Race of the Moment
Fix for a case where it was impossible to sprint in the last kilometers
Fix for a crash using teams not registered by default in Vlaanderen Classic
Improvement of the passage of the Champs-Elysées tunnel to favor massive sprints
Adjustment of the frequency of falls so that they can happen a little later in the Tour de France
Addition of Tour de France jerseys for teams Uno-X and Bahrain
Fix for a wrong jersey displayed in Pro mode simulation if the team has a specific jersey for the Tour de France
Modification of AI opponents on the final sprint phase with a new method to estimate sprint distances so that the sprinter and his train trigger their effort at the best time
Modified generic helmets for more realism
Fix for the Editor interface to correctly display arrows when changing notes
Application of the Tour regulations on all My Tour races, regardless of the startlist
PC Only: update of the “Controller required” warning screen
PC Only: keyboard support to enter names
Regarding Gino Mäder, we have decided in agreement with his team to withdraw him from the game. He is currently still available for the Paris Nice but will soon be withdrawn from all races.
Once again, the entire Cyanide and Nacon teams would like to offer their deepest condolences to his family, friends and team.
